identity.evidence: All six native 1672×941 frames retain one faceless white anatomical athlete, white trainers, one fixed two-post rack and one bar. Purple upper-back and lat fields stay attached to the same muscles.

camera.evidence: One side view and 1672×941 canvas across the set. Bar cap top-left is (111,22–23), rear post top-left exactly (512,23). anatomy.evidence: The athlete keeps a straight heel-to-shoulder plank. Elbows bend as the sternum moves near the bar and extend on the way down; no arm or leg disappears or changes side.

equipment.evidence: A single straight bar stays on the same two rack posts. Front rack foot spans 210–211 px and rear post top-to-foot span 718–720 px, each well under 1% dimension variation. contact.evidence: Both hands wrap the same fixed bar in every pose. Both heels and shoe soles stay supported; visible shoe sole bottoms are y896–897 native px. Rear rack and front foot do not visibly move at the delivered phone size.

physics.evidence: The torso rises toward the bar as elbows flex, then retraces to straight arms without breaking the body line. The bar stays fixed above the athlete.

muscles.evidence: Upper-back and lat regions are the strongest violet field, with biceps and core as secondary regions. Highlights remain on the same anatomy throughout.

cueAgreement.evidence: Hang, Pull, Chest, Squeeze, Lower, Extend captions align to poses 1,2,3,3,2,1. The top drawing brings the sternum near the fixed bar; the setup maintains a heel-supported plank.
